methodology: Served on node v26.8.1. oha oha 1.16.0: per route for 5s, keep-alive disabled (--disable-keepalive), latency-corrected (--latency-correction), JSON report. Each cell is run 3x after a discarded warmup and reduced to the MEDIAN run; requests_per_s_min/max report the spread. Served by 8 worker process(es) on 16 cores. Levels + routes configurable, matching upstream. Raw samples retain oha data; latency_range is slowest minus fastest.

concurrencyModel.note: The server workers and oha share this machine. Worker count is recorded per run; no scaling or competitor performance is inferred from this measurement.
